{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate the full dataset on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient, regardless of QC status
df_dedup_full = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Count total number of unique patients (enrolled, regardless of QC status)
total_enrolled = len(df_dedup_full)

# Print the final answer
print(total_enrolled)"}
